title: WHITE DUNES | Seagrove Beach, FL | Five Star Properties

description_expanded: White Dunes - Charming Seagrove Beach Retreat with Community Pool & Easy 30A Access Favorite Features: - Community Pool - Local Dining and Shopping - Five Minute Walk to Beach More about White Dunes: Discover the perfect Florida Gulf Coast vacation at this beautifully appointed 4-bed, 3-bath home in vibrant Seagrove Beach, FL — a relaxing retreat just minutes from the sugar-white sand beaches and emerald waters of Scenic Highway 30A. Nestled in a welcoming neighborhood with access to a refreshing community pool, this home offers an ideal mix of coastal charm and laid-back comfort for your next getaway. This stylish coastal home offers spacious living and modern comforts designed for families, friends, and multi-generational travel. Its thoughtful layout makes it easy for your group to relax and enjoy — perfect for travelers seeking classic beach living, community amenities, and easy access to everything 30A has to offer. Nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach, you’re a short stroll or bike ride to beautiful public beach access points — including three convenient public beach accesses near the home — along with boutique shopping, local dining, and the scenic Timpoochee Trail. Seagrove is known for having abundant access points to the Gulf, making it easy to reach the sand from nearly anywhere in the neighborhood. Seagrove’s laid-back Old-Florida vibe blends perfectly with nearby hotspots like Seaside, WaterColor, and Rosemary Beach along the scenic 30A corridor — giving you endless options for coastal fun and exploration.
